findings.summary: The new effect puts each connection counterpart's display name and account email in the export, which leaks another user's personal data and contradicts the 'authenticated owner only' isolation guarantee.
findings.evidence: effects: - Export authorized records of the authenticated owner only - The export also lists each active Connection with the counterpart's display name and account email

findings.summary: The component description lists 'connections' as an export category, but the affordance effect limits it to active Connections and adds counterpart identity fields, so the two scopes do not match.
findings.evidence: description: One export of contacts, goals, events and connections as a single JSON file
